text:
- [IARC.7.9] No wire / transport / RPC library. If an
  integrator wants to bridge libds across a process
  boundary, they pick and link their own encoder
  (msgpack, protobuf, JSON, anything) on their side
  per [IARC.1.14]; libds exposes typed C structs and
  lets the integrator decide. The protobuf-c
  dependency declared at [IARC.7.4] is
  artefact-load substrate ([IARC.1.15]) and does not
  reverse this.

---
